author: Tazz
body:
What modules would you like to see implemented to Nebula so you can use them in YML? Just comment below with what you would like to see to improve the quality of your maps, or even others!

Requests (I will add every reasonable request, and then to the right of it, in bold I will say if it gets completed.)
  • You can disable all block placing in the void, and then make regions to override that.
  • Normal height limit - you can just say: height limit = y for example
  • A normal spawn timer
  • Disable/ Enable safeties
  • Disable /Enable "The X wool have been touched!
  • Make it so monuments can be several blocks instead of just one!
  • Add a potion effects feature to kill rewards
  • Unlock monuments (after breaking one monument, another one becomes unlocked)
  • UUID's (updates player names in the YML if they change it)
  • Set villager trades
